translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Zaburi. Wer mar gwedho hekalu. Zaburi mar Daudi.

content.text: Abiro tingʼi malo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
nikech ne igola e bur matut,
kendo ne ok iyiene wasika mondo obed mamor kuoma.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha, ne aluongi mondo ikonya
kendo ne ichanga.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ne igola oko e liel,
ne iresa kane oyudo aridora piny e bur matut mar joma otho.
Werneuru Jehova Nyasaye, un joge maler;
pakuru nyinge maler.
Nikech mirimbe bedo mana kuom kinde matin kende,
to ngʼwonone osiko nyaka chiengʼ;
ywak nyalo bedo gotieno
to mor biro mana gokinyi.
Kane aparo ni adhi maber, ne awacho niya,
“Onge gima biro bwoga.”
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kane itimona ngʼwono,
ne imiyo achungʼ motegno kaka got;
to kane ipando wangʼi,
to piny nochama.
In ema ne aluongi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye;
Ruoth Nyasaye ema ne aywakne mondo okecha.
“Ere ohala ma thona biro kelo,
ere gima dhina e liel biro konyigo?
Buru bende nyalo paki adier?
Bende dohul adierani kasetho?
Winja, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, kendo kecha;
yaye Jehova Nyasaye bed konyruok mara.”
Ne iloko ywakna modoko miel;
ne igolo lawa mar kuyo mi irwakona law mor,
mondo chunya owerni kendo kik olingʼ.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha,
abiro goyoni erokamano nyaka chiengʼ.
